abstract: Sixteen patients with malignant ovarian tumors were treated conservatively; 1 had a serous cystadenoma of low potential malignancy; 6 had a mucinous cystadenoma of low potential malignancy; 2 had a pure dysgerminoma; 2 had a mature solid teratoma; 3 had a mucinous cystadenocarcinoma; and 2 had an endodermal sinus tumor. Postoperative chemotherapy was given in 12 cases and 1 patient with a pure dysgerminoma had radiotherapy. Eighteen pregnancies occurred in 13 patients. One full-term and one 8 month premature infant died in utero, and 2 infants had malformations; the other 14 infants are all well. The patient with moderately differentiated mucinous cystadenocarcinoma who delivered a premature infant and 2 patients with endodermal sinus tumors died of recurrence.
abstract_ja: 悪性卵巣腫瘍16例が保存的治療を受けた。内訳は、低悪性度の漿液性嚢胞腺腫1例、低悪性度の粘液性嚢胞腺腫6例、純粋ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）2例、成熟固形奇形腫2例、粘液性嚢胞腺癌3例、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例であった。術後化学療法は12例に施行され、純粋ディスジャーミノーマの1例は放射線療法を受けた。13例で計18回の妊娠が起こった。満期産の1児と8か月早産の1児は子宮内で死亡し、2児に奇形がみられたが、他の14児はいずれも健康である。中等度分化型粘液性嚢胞腺癌で早産児を分娩した患者と、卵黄嚢腫瘍の2例は再発により死亡した。
